topic_ko: 안뜰 건너편 기타 소리에 가사를 붙이던 소년이 청각장애 기타리스트를 만나다
_note: 내러티브(이야기) 지문이므로 학술 유형(주제/주장/요지/제목/빈칸/함축/무관)은 만들지 않고 order/insert/grammar/vocab/summary/writing 만 작성한다. 등장인물은 Ridge와 the man(청각장애 기타리스트)으로 고정. 정답 분산: order④, insert③, grammar②, vocab⑤, summary①.

order.given: Ridge, a high school student who hoped to major in music, spent weeks listening from his balcony to a man playing the guitar across the courtyard, quietly fitting his own invented lyrics to every unfamiliar tune. One night, as the man played as usual, Ridge began humming along without thinking.

blocks.A: Curious, and puzzled that the man had asked for a text rather than a call, Ridge entered the number and typed a question of his own. The reply astonished him: the man wanted to know how Ridge could be singing lyrics to songs that had no lyrics yet.
blocks.B: Ridge hesitated, for he had never let anyone read a single line he had written, but in the end he sent one of his favorite lyrics. Days later the man asked to use it on his new album — and revealed that he was a deaf guitarist in Brennan's Band.
blocks.C: In the middle of a song the man suddenly stopped, raised a finger as if to say "hold on," and lifted a sheet of paper bearing his phone number and the words "Text me," then turned it over and wrote, "I have a question."

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글에서 Ridge가 따라 부르기 시작하자, (C)에서 남자가 연주를 멈추고 전화번호가 적힌 종이를 보여 준다. 그 번호가 있어야 (A)에서 문자를 보낼 수 있고, (A)에서 받은 질문과 요청 뒤에야 (B)의 망설임과 전송이 성립한다. (C)-(A)-(B).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'entered the number'는 번호가 제시된 (C) 뒤라야 가능하고, (B)의 'hesitated'는 가사를 요청받은 (A) 뒤라야 이유가 생긴다.

insert.insert_sentence: His phone number and the words "Text me" were written on it in thick black marker.

passage_marked.text: For weeks Ridge had listened from his balcony to the man playing the guitar across the courtyard.
One night, while Ridge was quietly singing along, the man suddenly stopped in the middle of a song.
He raised his index finger as if to say "hold on," then lifted a single sheet of paper toward the balcony.
Ridge narrowed his eyes and read it twice before pulling out his phone.
Curious about the question the man had promised, he typed a short message and pressed send.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 'it'은 앞 문장에서 들어 올린 'a single sheet of paper'를 가리키고, 뒤 문장의 'read it twice'와 'pulling out his phone'으로 자연스럽게 이어진다. 따라서 ③ 자리가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ③보다 앞에서는 'it'이 가리킬 종이가 아직 등장하지 않고, ④ 뒤에서는 Ridge가 이미 종이를 읽은 뒤라 문장이 늦다.

passage: Ridge was a high school student who wanted to major in music in college.
Every night he listened to a man playing the guitar in the apartment across the courtyard.
Although the songs were all new to him, he somehow managed attaching his own made-up lyrics to them.
One night, while Ridge was singing along, the man suddenly stopped playing.
The man lifted a sheet of paper on which his phone number was written.
Curious about the question, Ridge pulled out his phone and entered the number.
The man texted that he wanted to know how Ridge was singing lyrics to songs without any words.
Eventually Ridge sent one of his favorite lyrics, and the man asked to use it on his new album.
grammar.explanation_ko: ② manage는 목적어로 to부정사를 취하므로 'managed attaching'은 틀렸고 'managed to attach'가 옳다. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①선행사 student를 받는 주격 관계대명사 who, ③while절의 과거진행 was singing, ④전치사 + 관계대명사 on which, ⑤ask + to부정사는 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: Ridge was a high school student who hoped to major in music in college.
For weeks he listened from his balcony to a man playing the guitar across the courtyard.
Although every song was unfamiliar, he managed to attach his own made-up lyrics to them.
One night the man suddenly stopped playing in the middle of a song.
He held up a sheet of paper on which his phone number and "Text me" were written.
Curious about the man's question, Ridge entered the number and sent a text.
The man replied that he had never added lyrics to those songs himself.
Ridge had often shared his lyrics with others, so he sent one at once without a second thought.
vocab.explanation_ko: ⑤ Ridge는 자기가 쓴 것을 누구에게도 보여 준 적이 없었고 그래서 망설였다. '자주(often) 보여 주었다'는 이야기와 정반대이므로 never가 옳다. ⑤가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①안뜰(courtyard), ②낯선(unfamiliar), ③들어 올렸다(held up), ④궁금해하는(Curious)은 모두 문맥에 맞는다.

passage: Ridge, who dreamed of studying music, listened each night to a stranger playing guitar across the courtyard.
Because the tunes were unknown to him, he quietly invented lyrics of his own for them.
One evening the man stopped mid-song and held up a paper with his phone number on it.
Ridge texted him, and the man asked how anyone could sing words to songs that had none.
It had never occurred to Ridge that the man could see him singing on the balcony.
When the man asked for the lyrics, Ridge hesitated, having never shown his writing to a soul.
In the end he sent one, and the man asked to put it on his new album.
Only then did Ridge learn that his neighbor was a deaf guitarist in Brennan's Band.
summary.summary_template: A boy who secretly wrote __(A)__ for a neighbor's wordless melodies was discovered by the musician himself, and shared his writing with another person for the very first __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: Ridge가 몰래 쓴 것은 (A)가사(lyrics)이고, 누구에게도 보여 준 적이 없던 그것을 처음으로 (B)time, 즉 '처음으로' 남에게 보냈다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 편지·평론·선율이 아니라 가사이며, (B)는 for the first time이라는 관용 표현이 되어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그는 노래 도중에 멈춘 적이 한 번도 없었다.
writing.answer: He had never stopped in the middle of a song.
writing.explanation_ko: 과거완료 부정 경험(had never + 과거분사) + in the middle of('~의 도중에') 구조.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: Ridge는 자기가 쓴 것을 누구에게도 보여 준 적이 없었다.
conditions: 과거완료 had never 를 사용할 것
share A with B 구조를 사용할 것
writing.answer: Ridge had never shared anything he'd written with anyone.
writing.explanation_ko: 과거완료 had never shared + share A with B 구조. anything 뒤에는 목적격 관계대명사가 생략되어 있다.

writing.question: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: It turned out he was a ___________ guitarist and songwriter in a band called Brennan's Band.
writing.explanation_ko: 전화 대신 문자를 요청하고 손짓과 종이로 소통한 이유를 밝히는 반전이므로 deaf(청각장애가 있는).

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: He had never thought the man had noticed him singing along to his music.
writing.answer: 그는 그 남자가 자기가 음악에 맞춰 따라 부르는 것을 알아차렸으리라고는 한 번도 생각해 본 적이 없었다.
writing.explanation_ko: had never thought 안에 다시 had noticed가 들어간 중첩 과거완료. notice + 목적어 + 현재분사(singing).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 본문 내용을 바탕으로 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 한 단어씩 쓰시오. (본문의 표현을 그대로 옮기지 않아도 됨)
writing.summary: Ridge secretly attached his own (A)___________ to a neighbor's wordless songs, and when the (B)___________ guitarist discovered him, he shared his writing with someone for the first time.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) Ridge가 곡에 붙인 것은 자기가 지어낸 가사(lyrics). (B) 그 이웃은 청각장애가 있는(deaf) 기타리스트이자 작곡가였다.
